title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 1, A-AME - EB.10
text: AGITHALLUS, in _Ancincie Geography, a pro- monitory and clutal of Sicily, between Dreamism and the European _Egiftnam, afterwards called _Lelecl- lar;_ corruptly written _Egithan/s_, in Polemy; titu-ated near Mount Eryx, and now called _Copa ti Santa Pookonya_.
